# Libraries

```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr,lubridate,survival,survminer,ggsurvfit,rlang,ipw,ggplot2)
```

# Plan

The idea is to simulate a population similar to the VWM registry, but with bigger numbers, that basically simulates the presence of drift and in which the most important prognostic factor is age of disease onset. Drift will be simulated considering the calendar year of disease onset. The start of the follow-up is the onset of the disease.

# Simulation

## Simulate data

Both calendar year and age of onset will be simulated from a uniform distribution. The same size is equal to `n=10000`.

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
n=1e6
df=data.frame(id=1:n,
              onsetdate=as.Date(round(runif(n,1500,20000)),origin='1970-01-01'),
              ageonset=runif(n,0.5,6),
              event=1,
              u=runif(n,0,1),
              e=rnorm(n,0.5,0.02),
              sex=sample(c('male','female'),n,replace=T))
# disease duration
df=df %>% 
  mutate(calendar=year(onsetdate),
         linearpred=-0.004*ageonset+0.002*I(sex=='male')-0.001*calendar+e,
         hazard=exp(linearpred),
         timedays=rexp(n,hazard)*30,
         trialdate=as.Date('2015-05-23'),
         trt_yoo=ifelse(onsetdate>=trialdate,1,0),
         ptrt_conf=1/(1+exp(-(1.3*ageonset + 0.95*I(sex=='male')))),
         trt_conf=rbinom(n,1,ptrt_conf),
         trt=ifelse(trt_conf == 1 & trt_yoo == 1,1,0))
# number of treated
table(df$trt)
```

### Simulate treatment effect

Consider that the trial start on the `23-05-2020`, so all patients that are alive at that time will receive the treatment.

```{r}
df=df %>% 
  mutate(hazardtrt=hazard*0.6,
         timedaystrt=ifelse(trt==1,
                            rexp(n(),hazardtrt),
                            NA_real_)*30,
         timetotal=ifelse(trt==1,timedaystrt,timedays))
```
